lessons_learned: Always run targeted tests after any DI change — new dependencies break existing tests silently
Flutter Web build artifacts (build/) can accumulate 1.1GB+ on disk — check during daily analysis
AGENTS.md must be audited for accuracy each run — stale port numbers, missing modules, dead tool references are common
When adding injectable dependencies to an existing service, ALL test files for that service must be updated with the new mock provider
Fruit persistence (FruitRepository) added to PublicApiService — getFruits() now queries DB, not proxying to fruityvice.com
Speech recognition rewrite (commit d751c52) replaces the speech_to_text plugin with a platform-aware abstraction — Web uses native Web Speech API, mobile uses the plugin
Quiz TTS now auto-reads questions & options with voice feedback on answers — requires no additional API calls
Game animations added: fade+slide quiz transitions, floating emoji decorations in country matching, leftTitle/rightTitle labels in matching games
